_comment: Hard dollar cap for the FIRST real (non-zero-token) AI E2E run across the Research -> Script -> QC -> Correction -> Final Technical Check chain. Enforced by .github/scripts/preflight_budget_guard.py BEFORE each real provider call. Historical paid usage is seeded below; new calls are conservatively reserved in the persistent GitHub Issue ledger before provider spend. Pricing is never guessed: the guard reads .github/config/cost-guard.json monetary.price_registry.
realized_spend_floor_note: Observed paid usage before the persistent reservation ledger: research $0.036876 + script $0.075060 + quality_control $0.056715 + failed correction(4500 output) $0.091722 + failed correction(5500 output) $0.106722 = $0.367095.

input_estimation._comment: Offline conservative estimate from the real prompt/system characters. The 1.40 margin replaces 1.15 after a Turkish correction run estimated 6777 input tokens but the provider reported 8074; over-estimation is intentionally safer than under-estimation.

research._comment: Planning ceiling around 6000 pre-margin input tokens; allocation covers the 1.40 safety margin plus the profile output ceiling.

script._comment: Input is the research issue's extracted top-3-ideas section only.

quality_control._comment: Input is bounded by the script output plus overhead.

correction._comment: Targeted correction sends only QC-blocked scenario blocks to the provider and deterministically preserves approved scenarios. The workflow-level preflight still prices the original full request conservatively; 2200 output tokens and a 7500 pre-margin input planning ceiling fit the $0.07 slice.

final_technical_control._comment: Input is the assembled final document plus QC context; 10000 pre-margin input tokens with the 1.40 safety margin and 1800 output tokens remain within $0.07.
